caption: A toy steam engine's boiler is heated by a small burner, and once the water boils, steam puffs from the cylinder and the flywheel begins to turn.

sa.check: A toy steam engine has a burner under its boiler.
The flywheel speeds up as the puffs grow.
Nothing on the engine moves before the steam appears.
The steam comes first and the turning follows.

pc.expect: The flywheel stays still until steam puffs from the cylinder, turns while the puffs come and slows when they stop.
pc.fail: The flywheel turns before any steam appears; or it keeps turning at the same rate after the steam has stopped; or it turns while the burner is out and the boiler dry; or it stops and starts again while the puffs come steadily.

pc.expect: The puffs and the wheel's turning go together: each puff comes as the piston moves and the wheel turns with them.
pc.fail: The wheel turns while the cylinder is dry with no puff at all; or the puffs come while the wheel stands still to the end of the clip; or the puffs come from the boiler's filler cap rather than the cylinder; or the wheel turns faster as the puffs die away.

pc.expect: The steam leaves the cylinder going up and spreads and thins.
pc.fail: The steam pours down the engine's base and pools; or sinks below the engine; or hangs as a fixed shape without rising; or pours downward out of the cylinder onto the table.

pc.expect: The flywheel turns about its own axle in one direction and the piston moves back and forth in line with the cylinder.
pc.fail: The wheel reverses direction with nothing changing; or wobbles off its axle; or the piston moves across the cylinder rather than along it; or the wheel turns while the connecting rod stays still.

pc.expect: One engine with one flywheel and one cylinder; the engine stays on the table and its parts stay attached.
pc.fail: The flywheel detaches and rolls away; or a second flywheel appears; or the piston passes out through the cylinder's wall; or the engine vanishes.

pc.expect: The engine's paint, the burner and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The engine changes colour; or the burner changes shape; or items on the table rearrange.
